Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain and stiffness. Over eight visits,
care consisted of spinal examination, range-of-motion assessment, soft tissue treatment, and a home stretching program.
Palpation revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar flexion, which are consistent with a lumbar strain. Straight
leg raise and neurological srceening were within normal limits, and no radicular signs were identified. No prior injury to the
lumbar region is known to this provider. Causation of the current findings relative to this collision has not yet been clearly
established. Recovery has progressed more slowly than typically expected for a strain of this type, and the plan is to reassess
function and the need for continued care at the next visit. Billing records for two similar charges on the same day are under
review by the office and are not addressed in this clinical summary.
